description: Retrieve historical annual financial reports (RGFI/GFI) submitted to FINA by a Croatian company over a specified range of reporting years using its OIB or MBS. To inspect detailed statutory line items (AOP codes), set include_aop_lines=true and provide aop_filter. RULES: Never invent financial figures, revenues, expenses, or identifiers. If identifier is missing, interview the user first.

aop_filter.description: Optional list of specific AOP codes to filter when include_aop_lines is true

include_aop_lines.description: If true returns full raw AOP JSON data

name: get_company_financials
